justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: No patient outcome benefit from PhD vs clinical doctorate in clinical practice.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 4-7 year doctoral program; eliminates clinical FTE during training; maximum time investment in allied health.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Zero clinical caseload applicability; relevant only in academic and research settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No clinical billing value; academic and research salary only; no CPT code or payer benefit.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Demanded in academic faculty, research scientist, and academic health system leadership roles; not clinical demand.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients do not differentiate PhD from clinical doctoral clinicians.
justifications.research.methodologyDepth: PhD curricula include multi-year coursework in biostatistics, study design, qualitative methods, and mentored independent research culminating in a dissertation.
justifications.research.publicationTrack: PhD-credentialed PT/OT faculty publish substantially more peer-reviewed papers than clinical-doctorate-only peers (Richter 2008; Jette 2014).
justifications.research.grantReadiness: Directly prepares trainees to write and win F31/F32, K01/K23, and R-series awards; most NIH rehab K-awardees hold a research doctorate.
justifications.research.pathwayToIndependence: Near-universal prerequisite for tenure-track PI positions and R01 eligibility in rehab science.
justifications.research.interdisciplinaryFit: Rehab Science PhDs commonly collaborate across PM&R, bioengineering, neuroscience, public health, and data science.
justifications.research.efficiency: 4-6 years full-time with stipend-level pay; highest opportunity cost of any rehab credential.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Consumers rarely choose a clinician because of a PhD; not a cash-pay driver outside niche thought-leader practices.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Can support premium positioning when paired with a clinical brand, but on its own is modest.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Rare among practicing clinicians, which provides some defensibility.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Doesn't inherently make a practice scalable; depends entirely on the business model built around it.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Most consumers don't distinguish PhD from DPT.
justifications.business.efficiency: 4-6+ years and major opportunity cost — extremely inefficient for business goals.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: The defining credential for tenure-track faculty roles and the standard for CAPTE/ACOTE programs.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Built explicitly around producing scholarship; the highest possible score.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Anchors curricula, doctoral mentorship, and research methods instruction.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Holders generate the evidence base itself.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Required or strongly preferred for almost all tenure-track lines.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Slowest and most expensive pathway, but the necessary one for the tenure track.
